humanity.heading: A research question shaped by missing patient data
humanity.text: In a 2023 interview, Naik recalled noticing a lack of patient data on hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) after joining UCSF in 2015. She began systematically collecting information from patient visits to better understand patients’ experiences and treatment responses. The article reports that she later partnered with Michelle Lowes in 2020 on HS PROGRESS. This is a dated account of her reported research motivation and approach; it does not establish current study enrollment, treatment availability, or clinical outcomes.
